title: fix(plugin-auth): a SCIM request refused by the provider's schema check names the connection its valid bearer belongs to
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-support-ai"} -->
_Requested by **Yibo Wang** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwB?thread=cmsg_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwBB2DodgkyibmHusDrxM6GVV)_

Fixes #32116

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么**:SCIM 请求体没通过供应商 schema 校验(格式错的 PATCH、缺 `userName` 的 POST /Users)而被拒 400 时,只要请求带的是一张有效的 SCIM 凭据,`scim_refused` 审计行现在会写上它的连接(actor `svc:scim:CONNECTION_ID`、`scim_connection_id`、凭据所属组织);伪造、已撤销、已过期的凭据和非 SCIM 凭据照旧记 `unknown`。
- **为什么改**:这类 400 在令牌校验之前就被拒,原来一律记成无连接,而 cloud 的 SCIM 控制台按 `svc:scim:` actor 过滤,于是 IdP 属性映射错误这种最常见的推送错误在连接下完全看不到。
- **风险与回滚**:风险低。SCIM 应答不变、不等待:解析在应答之后、且只对限流已放行的那一行做一次只读查询;不写凭据行(last-use 戳不动),令牌、其任何片段和摘要都不进事件、行或日志。回滚即还原本 PR。
- **先看**:`packages/plugins/plugin-auth/src/scim-refusal-audit.ts`(`withResolvedConnection` 与 `scimRefusalConnectionResolver`、模块头新规则),`packages/plugins/plugin-auth/src/scim-connection-service.ts`(抽出的只读 `findLiveScimCredential`,校验器先调它再打戳),`packages/plugins/plugin-auth/src/auth-manager-request-routing.ts`(SCIM 分支把解析器交给观察函数)。
- **两分钟验证**:`pnpm --filter @objectstack/plugin-auth exec vitest run src/scim-refusal-audit.test.ts`,预期 20/20 通过,其中 (6) 组「缺 userName 的 400 写上连接且不写凭据行」与三个对照(伪造/撤销/过期仍为 unknown)为绿。
- **需要你做的**:无,席位落地。

## What changes

A SCIM request whose body fails the vendor's schema is refused `400 invalidValue` BEFORE `@better-auth/scim` runs the bearer verifier, so `scimRequestScope` never gets a `connectionId` and the `scim_refused` event named no connection even for a valid bearer. Re-measured at `origin/main` 036a9fbf on the real `AuthManager` + sqlite harness: a malformed PATCH and a `POST /Users` with no `userName`, both with the connection's valid bearer, each answered 400 `invalidValue` and handed the slot `presentedCredential: scim_bearer` with no connection; 25 such PATCHes made 0 reads of `sys_scim_connection_credential` (the verifier never ran).

Following the seat's ruling section and its amendment:

- **Where.** `observeScimRefusal` takes an optional `resolveConnection`. Only when the observation carries no `connectionId` AND the `Authorization` header carries the minted SCIM prefix (`scimBearerOf`, the same shape test `presentedCredentialOf` already used) is it called. Every other case builds the event exactly as before.
- **How it resolves.** `findLiveScimCredential(engine, secret, token)` is extracted from `verifyScimBearerToken` in `scim-connection-service.ts`: keyed digest via `digestScimBearerToken`, `findOne` on `sys_scim_connection_credential` by `token_digest` with the system probe context, `scimCredentialIsLive`, non-empty `connection_id`. The verifier now calls it and then stamps last use (#32208's `ScimCredentialLastUseStamper`, unchanged); the refusal path calls only the helper. This is the only change in that file: a read-only helper extracted, no predicate copied.
- **Read-only.** The resolver never calls the verifier and never writes; the credential's `last_used_at` is not touched, so a refused request does not count as a use.
- **What the row carries.** The connection and, as the verified path records, the credential's `organization_id` (approved by the seat). The bearer, any part of it and its digest never leave `scim-connection-service.ts` / the module; the module header's "never verified again, digest never computed here" paragraph is replaced by the new rule stated exactly.
- **Answer and cost.** The lookup runs inside the existing `runAfterResponse` task, after the bound admitted the refusal. The bound is unchanged: for a scope with no connection it is keyed on the client address, and it admits BEFORE the lookup. So a refusal the bound drops costs no lookup and an admitted one costs exactly one: at most 20 lookups per address per 10-minute window and 1,000 across all keys. A resolved row therefore stays counted on its address key, not on the connection key (stated in the module header's bound section); moving it would need the lookup before admission, i.e. one for every refusal including the dropped ones.
- **Wiring.** `handleRequest`'s SCIM arm (`auth-manager-request-routing.ts`) hands `scimRefusalConnectionResolver(this.config.dataEngine, () => this.resolveAuthSecret())` when the scope named no connection; the secret is read only when a lookup runs, and no engine means no resolver (the verifier fails closed the same way). `resolveAuthSecret` joins the `handleRequest` host in `auth-manager.ts` (one member). These two files were added to the claim by the seat's amendment; `config.secret` alone would be wrong when the secret is database-resolved.

No doc line in `content/docs/permissions/` describes the `scim_refused` row's connection attribution (searched for `scim_refused`, `scim_connection_id`, `svc:scim`), so no doc change.

## Tests

`scim-refusal-audit.test.ts` (real `AuthManager` + `ObjectQL` on sqlite):

- **Changed:** "(1) 400 malformed PATCH (refused by the schema BEFORE the bearer verifies)" now expects the connection and organization; it pinned the old `unknown` reading.
- **New block (6):** a 400 `POST /Users` with no `userName` and the valid bearer names the connection and organization; the engine is handed no insert/update/delete on `sys_scim_connection_credential`, the row is byte-equal before and after, and its `last_used_at` stays empty; CONTROL: the same bearer on a request that verifies (`GET /Users`) does stamp `last_used_at`, so the column is live.
- **Controls (6):** a forged SCIM-prefixed bearer, a revoked credential (`revokeScimConnectionCredential`) and an expired one each still read `presentedCredential: scim_bearer` with no connection and no organization; a non-SCIM bearer reads `other` and the credential table is never read; the event never carries the bearer, a slice of it or its digest.

Clause-② measured: no accept set changes. A field that read `unknown` is now filled for a live credential; every answer status and body is unchanged (the existing (4) "answer never depends on the ledger" cases and the full suite stay green).

## Acceptance notes

- **Open question for the seat, not decided here:** whether a schema-refused request with a valid bearer should count as a credential use (`last_used_at`). Ruled out of this card; the lookup is read-only.
- A resolved row is bounded on the client-address key (see What changes). A connection whose IdP floods schema 400s from many addresses is bounded per address and by the global cap, as an unverified bearer was before.
- #32285 (in the merge queue) also touches `auth-manager-request-routing.ts` and `auth-manager.ts`; this branch is merged with `origin/main` at the head below, before #32285 landed.

## Verification

Readings at head bea1d8c1 on `objectstack-ai/objectstack` unless named otherwise.

<details><summary>Build, tests, typecheck</summary>

- `npx turbo run build --filter='@objectstack/plugin-auth...' --concurrency=2`: 36/36 tasks, lock VERDICT command-exit 0.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/plugin-auth test`: 259 files passed, 4747 tests passed, 10 skipped; lock VERDICT command-exit 0.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/plugin-auth typecheck` (tsc, examples, `check:test-typecheck`): exit 0.
- The five SCIM files (`scim-refusal-audit`, `scim-refusal-audit-bound`, `scim-connection-service`, `scim-connection-admin`, `scim-transaction-scope`): 67/67.
- Full dogfood not run: no `!` in the title and no `(narrowing)` arm.
</details>

<details><summary>Ablations (each through ablation-replace; restored, blob == HEAD, empty git diff HEAD)</summary>

- **The resolution names the connection.** `withResolvedConnection(...)` replaced by the bare observation: `scim-refusal-audit.test.ts` red, 2 failed / 18 passed — exactly the two positive cases ((1) malformed PATCH, (6) no `userName`); every control stayed green.
- **The resolution writes nothing.** The resolver made to stamp last use after the lookup (`ScimCredentialLastUseStamper.record`): red, 1 failed / 19 passed, "(6) … no credential write" (`expected [ [ 'update', … ] ] to deeply equal []`). A first attempt was refused by the tool before anything ran (the replacement contained the anchor, so the anchor count did not drop); it was redone with a non-overlapping replacement and that run is the one reported.
</details>

<details><summary>Derived gates</summary>

`node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands` derived 74 families for this change set; each was run at bea1d8c1 and recorded as `CMD :: exit N`. `--ran` answers "74 derived famil(ies) accounted for — 73 run, 1 NOT-MEASURED".

- NOT MEASURED: `pnpm check:dual-build-cjs-loads`, reason: PREREQUISITE NOT MET (it reads every package's `dist/`; this container built only the plugin-auth closure). Its self-test passed (93 cases); the scan is CI's.
- `node scripts/check-plugin-teardown-shape.mjs --self-test` first exited 3 on this shallow clone (its positive-control fixture commit 621a4876 was unreachable); after fetching that one commit it passed (48 cases), and that run is the one recorded.
- `check-changeset-no-major.mjs` ran with `--event` holding this PR body and title: exit 0.
</details>
